reviews.title: Disappointing & Emotionally Unsafe
reviews.text: Single City has potential, but the toxic social culture ruins the experience. Boundaries aren’t respected, harassment is often ignored, and the game lacks proper moderation. Everyone deserves a gaming space that feels safe, fair, and full of possibility—this game falls short. Until the developers address the emotional safety of players, I can’t recommend it.

reviews.title: Blaming players for glitches and allowing racists
reviews.text:
This game really had potential. Except for it has no moderators, no support from developers, and a surprising amount of racists. 

They allow these racists to go on hours long rants that would make hitler blush because they have no moderators and rely on players in the game to report offenses in order for them to take action. Sometimes it takes days for them to silence a player for making death threats or racist or homophobic remarks. 

In addition to all this, if the game glitches, they blame the players for “illegal gains.” 

It’s not illegal when it’s the developers own fault. Take some responsibility.

reviews.title: Major bugs
reviews.text:
Haven’t been able to get past the first task since downloading this game a couple of days ago. I was able to select an avatar and click the clean option for the first room, but that’s as far as it lets me go (outside of viewing that single room). Can’t move the screen around, if that’s even an option usually. Can’t open the task to talk to Gigi, and if I haven’t yet clicked on anything I can open the phone, but that’s it. Once opening it I can’t click on anything in the phone, nor will it let me exit out of it. Plus, the little indicator when pressing/clicking on things is still there, so I know that me clicking on things is being processed, but nothing is happening. Again, have had this game for a few days and no matter how many times I close and reopen the game, nothing changes. (also, I can view the chat at the bottom of the screen, but I also can’t access that).
Won’t give this 1 star since I have yet to even play the game, but I feel like this is quite a large bug that one would think would be fixed rather quickly, but that doesn’t seem to be the case here. Unless others have yet to mention this happening to them too?
